about.primary: Pragmatic builder -- I pair engineering precision with a bias for shipping. Senior Software Engineer (6 years) building secure, cloud-native backend systems and, more recently, practical applied-AI tooling. My through-line is leverage: turning constraints into outsized outcomes -- an internal AI test-generation agent that wrote ~20,000 lines of tests across 40+ modules at near-zero added cost; a monolith re-architected into microservices on Kubernetes with zero downtime; a multi-provider LLM prompt toolkit adopted across three teams. I also build in the open (PromptForge, AgentKit, QuickLog). Java/Spring, Python, Kubernetes, LLM apps, RAG. Always happy to connect and trade ideas with people who love hard problems.
